_comment: Benchmark micro-tasks for local-LLM dispatch (SPEC--LOCAL-LLM-DISPATCH-V2 FR-1/FR-6). checks_visible = same cases as acceptance in prompt; checks_holdout = NOT in prompt (gate runs both). Numeric compare eps default 1e-6.

rules: return x clamped to the range [0, 1].
if x is NaN return 0.
input format is exactly "MM:SS.mmm" (2-digit minutes, 2-digit seconds, 3-digit milliseconds).
seconds part must be 00-59; minutes 00-99.
return total seconds as a number.
any string not matching the format exactly -> return -1.
tasks.acceptance_prompt: parseTimecode("01:02.500") -> 62.5. parseTimecode("00:00.000") -> 0. parseTimecode("abc") -> -1. parseTimecode("1:02.500") -> -1 (minutes must be 2 digits).

tasks.signature: export function parseSrtCues(srt: string): { start: number; end: number; text: string }[]
rules: SRT format: blocks separated by one or more blank lines; each block = index line, then time line "HH:MM:SS,mmm --> HH:MM:SS,mmm", then 1+ text lines (join multiple text lines with "\n").
start/end are seconds (number).
handle both \n and \r\n line endings; trim each line.
skip malformed blocks (no valid time line) instead of throwing.
empty or whitespace-only input -> [].
tasks.acceptance_prompt:
parseSrtCues("1
00:00:01,000 --> 00:00:02,500
hello

2
00:00:03,000 --> 00:00:04,000
world a
world b") -> [{start:1,end:2.5,text:"hello"},{start:3,end:4,text:"world a
world b"}]. parseSrtCues("") -> [].

tasks.signature: export function sumClipDurations(clips: { start: number; end: number }[]): number
rules: sum (end - start) over clips where end > start.
ignore invalid clips: end <= start, or start/end not finite numbers.
round the final sum to 3 decimals.
empty array -> 0.
output format "MM:SS.mmm" zero-padded (minutes at least 2 digits).
round to the nearest millisecond FIRST (total milliseconds), then split into minutes/seconds/ms so rounding can carry over (e.g. 59.9996 -> "01:00.000").
negative or non-finite input -> "00:00.000".

tasks.signature: export function crossfadeGain(t: number, durationSec: number): { gainIn: number; gainOut: number }
rules: equal-power crossfade: p = t/durationSec clamped to [0,1]; gainIn = sin(p*PI/2), gainOut = cos(p*PI/2).
if durationSec <= 0 or not finite -> { gainIn: 1, gainOut: 0 }.
if t is NaN -> treat as t = 0.
numeric tolerance for acceptance: within 1e-6.

tasks.signature: export function pickKeys<T extends object, K extends keyof T>(obj: T, keys: K[]): Pick<T, K>
rules: return a NEW object containing only the given keys (own enumerable properties of obj).
do not mutate the input object.
duplicate keys in the list must not duplicate work or throw.
must type-check under TypeScript strict mode with the exact generic signature.

checks_visible.assert: (() => { const r = pickKeys({a:1,b:2,c:3}, ['a','c']); return r.a===1 && r.c===3 && Object.keys(r).length===2; })()

checks_holdout.assert: (() => { const o = {x:1,y:2}; const r = pickKeys(o, ['x']); return r.x===1 && Object.keys(r).length===1 && o.y===2 && Object.keys(o).length===2; })()
(() => { const r = pickKeys({x:1,y:2}, ['x','x']); return r.x===1 && Object.keys(r).length===1; })()
